policy.meaning: Each property is a CockroachDB table storage parameter under its own name. An omitted property leaves the engine's default. A flag is written only when true. The derived ttl marker is never present.

ptah.run/cockroachdb/row-ttl.constraint: One of ttl_expiration_expression and ttl_expire_after is required. Counts are at least 1. ttl_expire_after is an interval and ttl_row_stats_poll_interval a duration of at least one second, each in a form the owner reads. Text is not blank. The value requests exactly these parameters; its absence under complete source coverage requests no TTL.

One of ttl_expiration_expression and ttl_expire_after is present. Values keep the spelling the server stores. Absence on a table under complete read coverage is an observed absence; incomplete inspection belongs in coverage.

canonicalization: Strings must be valid UTF-8 and are kept verbatim, including whitespace and case. Property order carries no meaning. Do not read intervals or durations as values; comparison owns that.
